svg.title: The database schema
svg.desc: SavedCalculations has Id, OwnerId, Name, a Note, four JSON columns (Inputs, OtherHomes, Refinance, Strategy: one kind per row, and a comparison of homes sets Inputs and OtherHomes), CreatedAt and UpdatedAt, with an index on OwnerId and UpdatedAt. OwnerId is a foreign key to AspNetUsers.Id with cascade delete. UserPreferences has OwnerId, KeyFigureOrder and KeyFiguresHidden, one row per user who has arranged the key figures, also with cascade delete. Passkeys has CredentialId (the key), OwnerId, PublicKey, UserHandle, SignCount, Name, CreatedAt and LastUsedAt, one row per passkey, with a cascade delete from the user. Identity also creates roles, claims, logins and tokens tables, which stay empty here. __EFMigrationsHistory records the applied migrations.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
